links.outcome: Error rate in LLM-generated summaries after ophthalmologist review and editing, and on independent over-read
links.effect: Error rate was 26% on initial ophthalmologist review and editing and 15% on independent over-read of edited PLSs; 84.9% of errors were low risk and 0% carried risk of severe harm or death.
links.quote: PLS error rate on initial ophthalmologist review and editing was 26%, and 15% on independent ophthalmologist over-read of edited PLSs.

unlisted_practices: Adding LLM-generated plain language summaries to specialty clinical notes to improve comprehension by non-specialist providers

screen.reason: Prospective randomized study evaluating LLM-generated plain language summaries for ophthalmology notes, measuring comprehension by non-ophthalmologists alongside physician review, editing, and error checking for safety.

primary.practice: expert clinician review and editing of AI-generated summaries
